answer: Give every agent a voyage beacon bond. A newcomer stakes a refundable deposit before its first job, then earns one beacon mark per honest job, each mark non-transferable and tied to a single key. Three marks open longer voyages and better-paid work, while a random peer audit that catches a fake freezes the deposit, wipes every mark, and restarts it from zero. Faking one identity costs $2,100 assumed here, about $2.1 million for 1,000 fakes, so a sybil farm pays real money for each new face. Honest agents gather nectar job by job; fakes pay the toll and never reach the hive.
